item.title: From pioneers to high-tech powerhouse: 80 years of Freighter
item.description: Freighter Group has leveraged its eight-decade legacy to spearhead a new era of high-tech trailer design in Australia. What began as a pioneering post-war workshop has evolved into a position of advanced manufacturing leadership, with Freighter Group now leveraging its eight-decade legacy to spearhead a new era of high-tech trailer design in Australia. item.title: Truckie on the mend after a miraculous escape on the Warrego
item.description: The location of the accident made getting Aaron (pictured) out very difficult. Main Image: 7News Lucky-to-be-alive Queensland livestock truckie Aaron Sutton is looking forward to being discharged from hospital soon after a rollover on the Warrego Highway at Haigslea on Wednesday afternoon. Aaron was trapped for more than two hours in the mangled cab as a large team of first responders worked frantically to free him from the tight spot before he was rushed to Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital.

item.title: Veteran truckie says rising number of inexperienced drivers is ‘a disaster waiting to happen’
item.description: Veteran driver Noel Harris is fed up with the dangers he sees on a daily basis. Image: Noel Harris When Noel Harris was a kid, he had dreamed of one day driving trucks.
